# Voice Translate 0.10.0-rc.1

Pre-release of an independent Windows fork of [Voica](https://github.com/Inhum/voica-win)
by Ivan Ushakov. The original MIT attribution is retained.

## Changes

- Local Russian speech recognition, optional text editing and Russian-to-English translation.
- Independent application/update and installer identity; upstream GigaAM model source stays pinned.
- Fresh settings use local recognition with translation and AI editing off. Existing choices are preserved.
- Missing-model/key guidance opens the relevant settings section, in Russian and English.
- Complete third-party licenses in the installer and both portable archives; GigaAM attribution is written beside verified model files.
- Fixed clean-Windows startup of ONNX: four signed Microsoft Visual C++ runtime DLLs are embedded in every distribution. No separate Visual C++ installation or administrator rights are needed.
- Packaging verifies the pinned DLL architecture, version and checksums. Self-test now loads the real native ONNX runtime.

## Downloads

- `VoiceTranslate-Setup-0.10.0.exe` — per-user installer with .NET included.
- `VoiceTranslate-0.10.0-win-x64.zip` — portable, .NET included.
- `VoiceTranslate-0.10.0-win-x64-fx.zip` — smaller portable; requires .NET 8 Desktop Runtime x64.

Windows x64, Windows 10 1809 or newer. Keep all license files with portable copies.
The GigaAM model is downloaded separately. Packages are unsigned; this candidate is not a stable release.
About shows `0.10.0-rc.1`; installer numeric version and asset filenames use `0.10.0`.

## По-русски

Предварительная версия самостоятельного форка Voica для Windows: распознавание русской речи,
обработка текста и необязательный перевод на английский. Для новых пользователей перевод
и обработка выключены; существующие настройки сохраняются.

Исправлена загрузка ONNX на чистой Windows: нужные DLL Visual C++ Runtime встроены в EXE.
Устанавливать среду C++ отдельно не требуется. Варианту `-fx` нужна .NET 8 Desktop Runtime x64.
Установщик и portable-архивы содержат лицензии; модель GigaAM скачивается отдельно.
Файлы не подписаны. Это кандидат для тестирования, а не стабильный выпуск.
